name: HAND WHEEL AUTOCLAVE
desc: Fully Automatic Microprocessor-Controlled Vertical Laboratory Autoclave engineered with a specialized light-weight ergonomic hand wheel locking mechanism. Features a 75-liter SS304 sterilization chamber and 3 factory-default sterilization cycles.
features: Heavy-duty light-weight rotating Hand Wheel mechanism (Clockwise lock)
75 Litre flagship high-efficiency containment chamber envelope
3 factory default automated sterilization loops running at 121, 126, and 134°C
1 user-editable processing cycle with open parameter customization matrix
Specialized programmable No Exhaust or Drain condensation tracking option

specifications.Equipment Configuration: Fully Automatic Vertical Laboratory Autoclave Sterilizer Station
specifications.Lid Locking Mechanism Type: Heavy-duty light-weight rotating Hand Wheel mechanism (Clockwise lock)
specifications.Volumetric Processing Capacity: 75 Litre flagship high-efficiency containment chamber envelope
specifications.Chamber Dimensions (Dia. x L): Precise internal vessel clearance measuring exactly 400 mm by 600 mm
specifications.Material of Construction (MOC): High-Grade Corrosion-Proof Stainless Steel (SS304) for inner and outer walls
specifications.Primary Automation Controller: Microprocessor-Based digital temperature controller with in-built process timer
specifications.Display Panel Architecture: Integrated multi-line bright LCD screen tracking multi-parameter statuses
specifications.Concurrent Data Diagnostics: Live tracking of Temperature, Sterilization Time, and real-time Date and Time
specifications.Thermal Processing Spectrum: High-precision thermal tracking adjustable from 105 to 134 degrees C
specifications.Pre-Programmed Process Cycles: 3 factory default automated sterilization loops running at 121, 126, and 134 degrees C
specifications.Custom Process Adaptability: 1 user-editable processing cycle with open parameter customization matrix
specifications.Chamber Operating Pressure Scale: High-pressure engineering safety standard certified up to 0.22 Mpa
specifications.Manometric Pressure Tool: Front-mounted heavy-duty industrial analog dial pressure gauge
specifications.Chamber High-Pressure Seal: Heavy-duty self-inflating high-durability Silicone Rubber structural seal
specifications.System Process Timing Range: Programmable automated execution times setting from 0 to 99 minutes
specifications.Automated Steam Discharge: Smart auto-release steam valve system with automated post-cycle audio beep alert
specifications.Liquid Processing Safeguard: Specialized programmable No Exhaust or Drain condensation tracking option
specifications.Internal Sample Carrier System: Supplied complete with 2 Nos. heavy-duty perforated Stainless Steel baskets
specifications.Upstream Calibration Gateway: Integrated built-in Validation Port with secure nut locking interface
specifications.Electrical Power Input Load: Standard 220 Volts AC, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable electrical line link
specifications.Mobility Infrastructure Deck: Heavy-duty industrial rolling Caster Wheels providing smooth relocation layouts
specifications.Failsafe System Protection 1: Electronic Low Water Level sensor preventing dry-run heating damage
specifications.Failsafe System Protection 2: Automated Over Temperature automated thermal safety trip limits
specifications.Failsafe System Protection 3: Rear-mounted heavy-duty adjustable mechanical Over Pressure Safety Valve
specifications.Target Assay Applications: Microbiology Media Preparation, Waste Decontamination, Quality Control, and R and D
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on logic and heating elements
